latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "song-creation" skill, enabling multi-agent workflow for full song generation.
- Supports automatic task decomposition: lyric writing, music arrangement, and audio synthesis via distinct agent roles ("墨白", "和弦", "引擎") without requiring preconfigured agents.
- Integrates ComfyUI AceStep workflow for high-quality audio synthesis; compatible across OpenClaw deployments with suitable hardware.
- Provides detailed process templates and directives for each agent to ensure end-to-end music creation based on user requests in Chinese.
- Implements robust parameter and output management for consistent and stable music generation.
